dict.string: Tsukumo reads your schedule and changes its own blocks only after approval.
Tsukumo reads contacts you allow and imports selected people into private profiles. It never edits your address book.
Tsukumo contacts a model server only when you configure it and choose to send a message, and, when you turn on Claude from iPhone, answers your paired iPhone on the same Wi‑Fi.
Tsukumo uses the microphone when you press the mic to dictate. Audio is processed on this Mac and is not saved.
Tsukumo reads reminders and changes its own reminders only after approval.
Tsukumo converts dictation to text on this Mac. Review the text before sending it to your selected model.
